scenario.prompt: Register "Vendor SLA Data" (http://localhost:7804) with exactly one configured widget. Requirements: `runbook_markdown`: name "Runbook Markdown", description "Configured SLA runbook note.", endpoint /runbook-markdown, type markdown, sized w=12 h=8 on the grid, category "Runbooks", source "sla-runbook", runButton true; it caches results for 15 minutes. Time-based config converts to milliseconds: "cache results for N minutes" means staleTime N*60000; "auto-refresh every N seconds" means refetchInterval N*1000..
scenario.title: Compose the configured Runbook Markdown widget

notes: Write one JSON object per line.
Use only tools listed in scenario.allowed_tools.
The harness executes calls after the command exits and grades final state.
